source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of types of testing (PDF 63).

items: Unit testing: functions ya classes jaise alag hisse akele aazmati hai; Python ka unittest module aam istemal hota hai.
Integration testing: jaanchti hai ke code ke hisse mil kar kaise kaam karte hain.
Functional testing: jaanchti hai ke software user ke nuqta-e-nazar se tawaqqo ke mutabiq chale.
Regression testing: yaqeeni banati hai ke nayi tabdeeliyan purani features na torein.
